summary: Supervise inactive launches and pass explicit configured holder bounds (unit 7f-3)

schema.detail: No persistent schema or shared writer changes.

rules.detail: INACTIVE: no production caller or activation before 4c-2 and explicit activation. Declared deadline and configured max-hold ceiling are required before J; no policy defaults.

compatibility.detail: Concrete launches own a running keeper watcher. Holder pidfd wait observes watcher failure, and every released wait error retires J via kill/empty/sample/removal while preserving usage with typed uncertainty. B6 receives explicit --max-hold SECONDS, recomputed from whole seconds remaining to the declared deadline and capped by configuration before gated spawn.

manual.detail: Ignored real-kernel keeper-death fixture documents the isolated gsr-pilot command with explicit approved cgroup root, slice, plan, test timeout and ceiling. It uses a raw gated holder, not gate-slot proof, and tears down only its unique fixture scope. Cargo and native execution not run.

recovery.detail: Missing/expired deadline and missing ceiling refuse before J. Watcher errors never permit a rerun or discard a confirmed retirement sample. B6 max-hold bounds execution duration after command launch, not queue time; absolute deadline supervision remains an activation/cancellation responsibility.
